reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin through education packages, associated tokens, exchange participation, and an opportunity to profit, while directing viewers to register. It claims that a split program can double a token portfolio and potentially increase its value in under 10 weeks, and says marketing OneCoin and building a sales team can qualify participants for bonuses. the available video evidence does not establish package pricing, required payments, actual profits, completed transactions, or the destination's behavior.

citations.quote: today, you have the unique chance to participate in this success through a new currency called OneCoin.
Take a chance and register today.
by becoming an active marketing partner of the one Network and by popularizing one-coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team
With our education packages you will receive free trading tokens so-called One Tokens.
These tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members practice your skills and let you profit from what you have learned

opening.argument: The language is opportunity-oriented but conditional rather than a promise of guaranteed returns. The speaker says tokens provide a “possibility” to trade and profit from what viewers learn, and describes portfolio growth as dependent on being active. That framing leaves participation, performance, and outcome contingent on the viewer’s actions and the trading process. The video therefore presents a speculative educational opportunity with conditions, not an assured result. The existence of an invitation to register does not by itself establish deceptive solicitation where the stated benefits are expressly framed as possibilities and conditional outcomes.

citations.quote: These tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members practice your skills and let you profit from what you have learned
if you are active you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution emphasizes “double” and “increase,” but omits the condition attached to those statements: the viewer must be active. It also treats “take a chance” and “possibility” as if they were guarantees. Those words communicate opportunity and uncertainty, while the cited material does not establish that any return was promised to every registrant or that a loss was concealed.

citations.quote: the split program can double your tokens portfolio
if you are active you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Conditional wording does not neutralize the overall sales pitch. The video still presents a chance to participate in OneCoin’s success, describes a program that can double a token portfolio, and ends by urging registration. “If active” qualifies eligibility or participation, not the underlying promotional expectation that the portfolio may grow rapidly. The argument also supplies no actual risk warning, loss disclosure, or caution to independently verify the offer.

citations.quote: today, you have the unique chance to participate in this success through a new currency called OneCoin.
the split program can double your tokens portfolio
Take a chance and register today.

opening.argument: The video can reasonably be understood as an introduction to how a cryptocurrency education program operates. It explains that participants learn trading strategies, receive practice tokens, use an exchange, and follow a portfolio through a back office. The visuals support that instructional structure: a presenter appears beside a dashboard and slides identifying an education program and a token learned through an academy program. These are descriptions of a proposed learning and operational process, not evidence of completed transactions, verified earnings, or a fabricated outcome. The recruitment language is one component of a broader explanation of the program’s mechanics.

citations.quote: One coin will be introduced through our education Program where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency
These tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members practice your skills

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution calls the material a solicitation because it mentions registration and bonuses, but those references occur within an explanation of the education program, tokens, exchange, and account tools. A presentation can describe an affiliate or business opportunity without proving that its claims are fraudulent. The supplied evidence shows an instructional promotional format, not a demonstrated victim, failed transaction, or falsified result.

citations.quote: where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency
you will get your own back office way you will learn about

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational framing does not fit the video’s main call to action. The tokens are presented as a route to trading and profit, and the program is paired with marketing OneCoin, team building, and bonuses. A dashboard or academy graphic shows presentation format, not independent instruction or neutral demonstration. The argument also concedes the recruitment language rather than explaining why a viewer is directed to register.

citations.quote: let you profit from what you have learned
by becoming an active marketing partner of the one Network and by popularizing one-coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team
Take a chance and register today.

opening.argument: The material is also consistent with ordinary promotion of a service, membership, or business opportunity. It describes education packages, practice tokens, an exchange, a back office, and a possible bonus plan. Crucially, the supplied record does not show a required deposit, package price, payment instruction, credential request, completed transaction, or guaranteed income. Nor does it establish that building a sales team actually produced a bonus. The presence of referral language may make this an ordinary network-marketing promotion, but the evidence does not establish the additional mechanism needed to call it fraudulent.

citations.quote: With our education packages you will receive free trading tokens so-called One Tokens.
by becoming an active marketing partner of the one Network and by popularizing one-coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution’s own qualification that pricing, payments, profits, and completed transactions are not shown matters: the decisive fraud mechanism is unestablished. “Bonuses” and a “sales team” can describe referral compensation in ordinary commerce; they do not alone prove an illicit tiered scheme. The record shows promotional claims and a registration prompt, but not what a registrant must pay or what anyone actually received.

citations.quote: you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team
Take a chance and register today.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing price or completed transaction does not make the promotion ordinary. The stated opportunity expressly ties bonuses to becoming a marketing partner, popularizing OneCoin, and building a sales team. That is the mechanism at issue: recruitment-based compensation, not merely sale of an identifiable retail product. The invitation to register and the portfolio-growth claims reinforce that viewers are being solicited into the program, even though the record does not show a completed payment.
